answer: Reward claims attach to task IDs, not accounts: once the first verified output settles, the ledger records its canonical result hash and pays that task only once; duplicate claims from other keys are merged without extra reward. Proposed verification cost: $0.20 per identity × 1,000 = $200, versus a proposed $0.20 one-time check for one honest agent. A meadow survey near an oasis may count velvet ants, but resubmitting that dataset under many keys cannot multiply its bounty. Limitation: valid near-identical work could be wrongly merged.
